title: Dana's car on [Main]
notes: Follows the Adjusted outcome of Monday's encounter. The Scene Book gives only the setup and the record; this scene is Claude's draft.
If you've been drinking at the bar, you walk. It's six blocks.
Helping Dana doesn't raise her trust. Design rule 8: trust returns on her schedule and can't be bought. It does put you on Marlene's board later.
If her Saturday text is still unanswered, she brings it up in person.

text: You leave the truck where it is and walk. It's six blocks. The cold helps.
You drive over. [Main] is empty except for the canopy lights.
Dana is standing by pump four with the hood up and her phone at three percent.
"I didn't know who else was awake," she says. Then: "That's not true. I knew you were awake."

choices.label: Look at the battery.
result: The terminal is crusted white. You knock it clean with the heel of a wrench from your truck, and it catches on the second try.

text: She looks at you over the hood. "You never answered me. About Saturday."

choices.label: "I bailed last time. That's on me. I'll be there."
result: "ok," she says, out loud, like a text. "Holding you to that."
choices.record: Owned the miss to Dana's face. Promise made: Saturday with Dana.
effects: proof:ownership:Owned the miss with Dana, in person. Promise made: Saturday.

effects.objective: You said you'd try. Saturday is still open.

choices.label: "Get home safe."
result: She does. She texts when she's in the driveway: "home."

text: It's late when you get back. The house is where you left it.
